project.name: OPlague
native_surfaces: native desktop UI and Pytyliki FFI

quality.intent: Inspection safety, evidence quality, failure containment and trustworthy reports.

criteria.requirement: Device relationships preserve stable identity and explicit uncertainty.
criteria.verification: Device graph tests cover graph assembly and relationship invariants.

criteria.requirement: Driver findings distinguish sourced observations from derived conclusions.
criteria.verification: Evidence tests cover provenance and reportable evidence.

criteria.requirement: Inspection reports preserve status, evidence and machine-readable boundaries.
criteria.verification: Report composition tests cover stable output assembly.

multiplicity.intent: Repeated and batched inspections remain bounded, comparable and auditable.

criteria.requirement: Batch inspection defines input limits and reports per-item outcomes.
criteria.verification: Inspection batch tests cover batching and outcome aggregation.

criteria.requirement: Federated snapshots and transfers use explicit versioned contracts.
criteria.verification: Federation tests cover repeatable import, export and validation paths.

criteria.requirement: Metric analysis uses stable inputs and reproducible calculations.
criteria.verification: Metric analysis tests cover calculation and report consistency.

native.intent: OS-facing data collection and desktop behavior remain explicit, native and capability-aware.

criteria.requirement: Driver and device inspection stays within explicit OS-facing interfaces.
criteria.verification: UDRV inspector tests cover native inspection boundaries.

criteria.requirement: Cross-project native calls use a narrow FFI boundary with explicit error handling.
criteria.verification: FFI tests cover the Pytyliki interoperability boundary.

criteria.requirement: Desktop visual behavior follows a consistent platform-aware theme and motion system.
criteria.verification: UI tests protect theme and motion contracts.
